info.title: Dreamcore private versioned feedback
info.description: Owner-only feedback about an exact task attempt/revision and presentation version. Tenant/space/material authorization is enforced on every read/replay/action. No source prose is implicitly copied. Score is not permission or proof. Lifecycle purge scrubs source-bound content; platform administrators cannot collect tenant feedback prose. Independent publication targets contain no private task identifier; the opinion is private to its author and depends solely on the published material version.

get.summary: Read own feedback for one exact observed target

post.summary: Create exact private feedback; stable requestId required

get.summary: Read three explicit personal expression preference slots
Read own feedback with current source authorization

post.summary: Revise or restore feedback by expected revision
Withdraw opinion; independent actions retain their own state

get.summary: Read exact receipts under source authorization
get.description: Client receipts exclude EXPERIENCE_CANDIDATE before pagination. Historical/internal records remain available to internal services.

post.summary: Perform independently confirmed action once per feedback revision
post.description: Only personal preference and correction actions are available in the first client release. EXPERIENCE_CANDIDATE returns 409 EXPERIENCE_CLIENT_DISABLED after access verification, without creating an action or candidate. Retained schemas describe historical/internal records.

FeedbackAssessment.description: Channel-specific reasons and ratings are validated by the server. NOT_USEFUL requires at least one reason or a nonblank suggestion; CUSTOM requires a nonblank suggestion. Feedback does not prove task success.

FeedbackFollowUp.description: Explicit independent confirmation required. Preference uses safe enums only. Correction creates a source-bound private task, not a successful correction. Candidate is manual, source-bound, unevaluated and never auto-published.

targetWorkspaceId.description: Explicit destination of a publication reader’s private follow-up; absent on legacy receipts.

FeedbackAction.description: Exact accepted receipt, not current downstream state. One action per kind per feedback revision. Repeated same payload returns the same receipt. Generic separately confirmed preferences survive feedback withdrawal. Derived correction/candidate prose remains source-bound.
